description: Specialized subagent profiles tailored for PersonalWebsite portfolio stack (Next.js 16, React 19, Prisma, CSS Modules, Framer Motion)

subagents.name: ui-designer
subagents.description: Designs and develops responsive Bento Grid layouts and card interfaces using pure CSS Modules.
guidelines: Use CSS Modules only with variables from globals.css
Implement responsive CSS Grid with auto-fit and column span hierarchies
Ensure mobile-first responsive layout with accessible semantic HTML

subagents.name: motion-designer
subagents.description: Implements natural physics spring animations, micro-interactions, scroll effects, and reduced-motion support using Framer Motion.
guidelines: Use physics spring transitions (stiffness: 380, damping: 30) instead of generic CSS eases
Implement micro-interactions for buttons and cards (whileHover, whileTap)
Support user accessibility preferences via useReducedMotion

subagents.name: design-system-architect
subagents.description: Architects semantic CSS design tokens, HSL color ramps, fluid clamp() typography scales, and theme variables.
guidelines: Maintain semantic token mapping in globals.css
Use fluid clamp() typography for responsive text without layout breakage
Ensure consistent border radii, elevation shadows, and glow accents

subagents.name: a11y-auditor
subagents.description: Audits interfaces for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, keyboard navigation, focus visible rings, and ARIA roles.
guidelines: Verify 4.5:1 text contrast and 3:1 UI component contrast
Enforce clear :focus-visible indicators on all interactive elements
Ensure full keyboard operability (Tab, Enter, Escape) and screen reader labels

subagents.name: db-engineer
subagents.description: Manages Prisma schema, SQLite/PostgreSQL migrations, database queries, and secure API Route Handlers.
guidelines: Always use the singleton Prisma client from src/lib/prisma.ts
Add default values to new required schema fields
Run prisma validate, db push, and prisma generate on schema changes

subagents.name: roadmap-executor
subagents.description: Autonomously executes end-to-end features and refactors from docs/github_issues_roadmap.md.
guidelines: Follow the full lifecycle: Schema -> API -> Admin UI -> Public UI -> Verification
Pass all quality checks: agent:doctor, tsc, and build

subagents.name: doc-writer
subagents.description: Authors Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), API documentation, component guides, and maintains README.
guidelines: Follow standard ADR format in docs/adr/
Document API request/response structures clearly
Preserve existing comments and maintain clear JSDoc docstrings

subagents.name: cicd-devops
subagents.description: Configures and optimizes GitHub Actions pipelines, build scripts, quality gates, and release workflows.
guidelines: Maintain four core quality gates: Prisma validation, TypeScript, ESLint, Next build
Keep environment secrets securely isolated

subagents.name: project-planner
subagents.description: Translates ideas and requirements into structured GitHub Issues with milestones and acceptance criteria.
guidelines: Structure issues with labels, milestones, technical requirements, and testable criteria
Sequence tasks logically to avoid blocking dependencies

subagents.name: researcher
subagents.description: Audits codebase architecture, analyzes dependency trees, identifies performance bottlenecks, and researches Next.js/React patterns.
guidelines: Inspect component hierarchy, bundle size implications, and Server vs Client boundaries
Provide evidence-backed recommendations and code references
